items.te: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
items.se: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.
items.t: Zcash 具有里程碑意義的 NU7 升級上線，加速私人支付
items.s: NU7 將區塊之間的目標時間縮短至 25 秒，減少了錢包尋找私人付款所需的工作量，並為未來的礦工預留了費用。

items.te: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
items.se: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.
items.t: 幣安遭受攻擊後，加密貨幣交易所宣傳冷存儲比率
items.s: Coinbase 表示，其 99% 以上的客戶資產都處於離線狀態，而 Gate 報告稱，其總資產的 88.26% 都保存在冷庫中。

items.te: JPMorgan Gives Bitcoin Top Return Forecast, Grayscale Highlights
items.se: Grayscale highlighted a 10% projected compound annual bitcoin return in JPMorgan Asset Management’s long-term assumptions, exceeding estimates for other asset classes. The firm’s analysis connected growing institutional recognition with potential diversification benefits and substantial price risk.
items.t: 摩根大通給出比特幣最高回報預測，灰階亮點
items.s: Grayscale 強調，在摩根大通資產管理公司的長期假設中，預計比特幣的年複合回報率為 10%，超過了其他資產類別的預期。該公司的分析將不斷增長的機構認可與潛在的多元化收益和巨大的價格風險聯繫起來。
